characters.name: 00.01(Luther Hargreeves/Spaceboy)
characters.description: Alliterative Name: Early concept art shows that his name was originally going to be "Dr Darwin". Big Good: The closest thing to one the series has at the beginning of the series. He considers himself the leader of the Umbrella Academy and goads his team the most to action. Taken literally when he was transplanted onto the gorilla. Subverted when in a fit of depression he becomes a fat gorilla stuck to his TV set because there's nothing heroic to do. Big Eater: He ends up eating himself into depression at the start of the "Dallas" story arc, as there is absolutely nothing heroic to do after the siblings saved the world. And not the first time he's seeing eating around, like in "You Look Like Death" when he's caught by Klaus eating cooking in secret inside the pantry. Blessed with Suck: How he sees himself after the head transplant. Fat Slob: Becomes this in theDallasarc thanks to depression.

characters.name: 00.02(Diego Hargreeves/The Kraken)
characters.description: Anger Born of Worry: He loses it on Vanya's face after she almost got killed by a robot, but he disguises it as being incredibly mad at her for leaving the family, even saying thathe has no sister. Of course, it's slightly revealed that he didn't meant to say this at all, and he later tries to apologize to Vanya... while she's already in the process of destroying the world. Batman Parody: Is a gritty superhero in the style ofBatmanwith shades of being aWolverine Wannabe. Charles Atlas Superpower: Despite lacking superhuman strength, Kraken is strong enough to impale a man with his fist. Disproportionate Retribution: He once broke someone's jaw because the guy threw a drink at Vanya. Disowned Sibling: Rejects Vanya's return, and tells her he has no sister.

characters.name: 00.03(Allison Hargreeves/The Rumor)
characters.description: Artificial Limbs: Allison has a cybernetic left hand implanted after Dr. Terminal ate her real one. ComeDallasshe seems to have had it replaced as well. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: Well, her face is saved from the apocalypse, buther throat... Bound and Gagged: Dr Terminal captured her as a child and gagged her to stop her using her power. Compelling Voice: One of the more perverse side-effects of Allison's power is that she can persuade people if she talks about certain feelings. For instance, she has an ex-husband who she made fall in love with her. Out of her influence, said husband is very bitter about it and doesn't want to see her ever again. Cool Big Sis: She becomes one, patiently helping Vanya with physical therapyeven though she almost killed her.

characters.name: 00.04(Klaus Hargreeves/The Séance)
characters.description: Asian Babymama: Sadly aMissing Mom; we only see the Asian baby and the grandmother he leaves it with. Astral Projection: Uses this to contact Luther after he's kidnapped by Hazel and Cha-Cha. Barred from the Afterlife: God sends him back to Earth saying that the Devil won't want him either. Cunning Linguist: Learned Vietnamese during the time he ran a strip club in the country. Demon Slayer: Sets up shop as one at the end ofYou Look Like Deathafter defeating Vivian Clarke.

characters.name: 00.05(Number Five/The Boy)
characters.description: The Ageless: Pogo's testing in 5 show that he no longer ages. Later confirmed tohave been done to him by the Temps Aeternalis. Ax-Crazy: By his own admission, Number Five is a complete psychopath who has to focus hard to suppress his daily murderous impulses.Indeed, he was made an assassin and implanted with DNA from various murderers throughout history.Whenever he has a legitimate excuse to let go, he will murder his targets with utter glee. Badass in a Nice Suit: Is always in a suit even when gunning down hordes of mooks. Cast from Lifespan: Inverted in one of the side stories where he says he can't use his power any more in case he de-ages back into an infant. Face on a Milk Carton: His face appears on a carton at the end of issue #6. He went missing twenty years previous, so why would they still be using it?

characters.name: 00.06(Ben Hargreeves/The Horror)
characters.description: The Cape: Dressed and acted like a traditional superhero. Gratuitous Japanese: Is seen greeting "happy birthday" in Japanese to a pink serpentine monster that crawled out of his body. Lovecraftian Superpower: He could summon horrifying monsters through his body. Nice Guy: The Horror was one of the most well-adjusted and meek of the siblings, contrasting his monstrous power. Posthumous Character: He's long dead by the beginning of the series.

characters.name: 00.07(Vanya Hargreeves/The White Violin)
characters.description: Amnesiac Hero: Has no memories in "Dallas" due to being shot in the head at the end of the previous series. Amnesiacs Are Innocent: Early in theDallasarc it's established that after the surgery on her brain she can neither move nor remember anything, prompting a disgruntled Allison tostrap her to a wheelchair and leave her in a room full of horrible news breaks. Apocalypse Maiden: If you let the White Violin finish a symphony, you'll probably never live to hear it. Brainwashed and Crazy: In the final third of theApocalypse Suite. Brutal Honesty: She held backnothingin her book, including her siblings' worst vices and insecurities.

characters.name: Sir Reginald Hargreeves/The Monocle
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Hargreeves was a horrible person who had no business being a parent. Heck, he even hated being called "Dad"! Even Evil Has Standards:Downplayed, as calling Hargreeves straight out "evil" would undermine his very complex character, but he is outrightshockedasthe Sparrows as kids straight up blow an entire plane, full of passangers, just to kill a wolfman that was inside of it, and he can barely finish his words while talking to them. Also, he built the Hotel Oblivion precisely to depose of a large number of VERY dangerous supervillains in a more "humane" way instead of sending them straight to jail, a place where they would no doubt easily escape. Fish People: When Klaus sees his ghost, one panel has him looking like the Gill Man fromCreature from the Black Lagoon. This is presumably his true appearance. For Science!: Apparently the reason he set out to find all the suddenly-born children. Goggles Do Something Unusual: Number 5 tries on the monocle and sees Pogo getting his brain operated on, implying it has some recording and playback ability or lets you see the past.

characters.name: Dr. Phinneus Pogo
characters.description: Alliterative Name: His first and last names both begin with the letter "P". Apes in Space: Implied as his statue has him wearing a spacesuit. Cold-Blooded Torture: The experiments on Pogo involved restraints and sleep deprivation. Intelligent Primate: He is a genetically enhanced chimp who is highly intelligent. Killed Off for Real:The first and bloodiest victim of the White Violin's rampage.

characters.name: Grace Hargreeves
characters.description: Ambiguously Evil: So far in the 'Plan B' story arc, she's shown to renegate her old UA children for the Sparrows, withplans to keep everything under control by using the Sparrows as a superhero police, even using the words "peace through force". She outright says all this to the public with a speech, bringing a military coup and dictatorship to mind. When she’s asked by a reporter why she’s doing all this,she even parrots the exact same words that the ALSOAmbiguously EvilHargreeves said when he was asked why he was adopting the children years ago. Armless Biped: She's supposed to wear arms but she finds them uncomfortable. Heel–Faith Turn: She tries to convert a post-amnesia Vanya to Christianity, on the basis that "nothing else has worked out for you". Hidden Disdain Reveal:Downplayed, as Grace mentions at Hargreeves' funeral how he was a bad father and an even worse husband, but that he cared too much about the world to let family and relationships get in the way. However, Grace off-handedly but surely mentions how the Mansion was a monument to Hargreeves’s failures and disappointment, and how he died emptied by defeatafter herHeel–Face Turnin 'Plan B'. Parental Favoritism: InHotel Oblivion, Grace implies that Vanya is her favorite.

characters.name: Abhijat
characters.description: Ace Pilot: He's shown to pilot The Minerva, the UA's massive ship. Battle Butler: He's always called a 'bodyguard', but he also dedicates himself to clean and serve like a regular butler whenever not on a mission. The Jeeves: Almost always by Hargreeves' side whenever he was on his own missions, in his lab and in his mansion. So Proud of You:A downplayed example, after is revealed that Abhi was in Japan all this time, he says he couldn't be around the family anymore after they've seem to lost their way, but now they seem to be a little more grown up. Put on a Bus: After the first issue of the 'Dallas' arc, he just disappears from the story. Until...

characters.name: Inspector Lupo
characters.description: The Commissioner Gordon: A more bitter, jaded, but nonetheless well-intentionedExpyof the original trope maker. False Teeth Tomfoolery: In almost every scene with him, his false teeth are mentioned or shown in any way. Hand Cannon: A classic jaded inspector should never be seen without one. Must Have Nicotine: Almost never seen without a cigarette in his mouth.

characters.name: Orchestra Verdammten
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: Enough to want to destroy the world with their music, and don't give two rat's ass if they die in the process. Card-Carrying Villain: Classical musicians who are also self-identifying mass-murderers and psychopaths. Wicked Cultured: Well, theyarea classical orchestra, right?

characters.name: The Conductor
characters.description: Affably Evil: "May I interest you in destroying the world?" Card-Carrying Villain: He becomes positively giddy at the notion of destroying the world, executes subordinates at the drop of a hat, and remarks it just wouldn’t be as much fun to only kill a few people. Dying Smirk:He dies with a smile on his face. Presumably because everything's going to plan. Half the Man He Used to Be:Immediately after her transformation, Vanya bisects the conductor with a single note from her violin. No Name Given: Referred to only as “The Conductor”.

characters.name: Temps Aeternalis in general
characters.description: The Ageless: They were able to halt Five's aging process, so it's likely something they do to all agents. Eye Scream: Five gouges the eyes of one of them with his thumbs. Gas Mask Mooks: All the unnamed ones wear red gasmasks. Join or Die: They give Five this choice. Time Police: They're dedicated to the preservation of the time continuum by manipulating and removing anomalies from the time stream.

characters.name: Carmichael
characters.description: Cruel and Unusual Death: Number Five takes revenge on Carmichael by swallowing him whole. Horrible Judge of Character: If he wanted to save the timeline and the world, why in all heavens would he actually hire people likeHazel and Cha-Cha? Knight Templar: Murder and blackmail are his go-to for saving the timeline. Meanwhile In The Past: Threatens Five by telling him he has two agents on standby to attack his mother two days before she gives birth. Unwitting Instigator of Doom: By sending Hazel and Cha-Cha to retrieve Five, he sets in motion the absolutely destruction of the world via nuclear bombs that they find in the Mansion.

characters.name: Hazel and Cha-Cha
characters.description: Axe-Crazy: Itreallydoesn't take much to set them off. Bantering Baddie Buddies: They're a pair of super-effective assassins who are never seen apart, withbasically the same personality. Their banter in partiular is of thechildishvariety. Batter Up!: They knock Klaus out with a baseball bat when kidnapping him. Decomposite Character: Concept art showed there was originally supposed to be one elite assassin called Bruno who wore aMickey Mousehead. This version was scrapped for copyright reasons. The Dreaded: After easily taking down an army of the Temps'Gas Mask Mooks, Five declares he's already dead when hearing that Hazel and Cha-Cha are coming next.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: All Your Base Are Belong to Us: They banish the Umbrella Academy from The City then repair and take over their old base. Anti-Hero Substitute: They take over the Umbrella Academy's base and operate as The City's main superheroes but violently kill any villains they encounter. Domino Mask: Played straight with four out of the seven Sparrows, who are seen wearing masks identical to the Umbrella's, except red instead of black. Averted with the other three: One wearssunglasses, another one is acube, and the last onedoesn't even have a face. The Dreaded: The supervillains who escaped from Hotel Oblivion are that terrified of them that they turn themselves into the police or deliberately get caught by Diego, hoping to be put into protective custody. Severed Head Sports: They unwind by playing soccer with the head of a criminal they killed.

characters.name: Sparrow Number One
characters.description: Flight: He can be seen flying while beating up criminals (Though, as all the Sparrows can be seen flying, this may be from another member's powers). Flying Brick: Number One has super strength and is seen flying throughout the entirety of his debut. Super-Strength: His main power. He possesses immense strength similar to Luther's.

characters.name: Carla
characters.description: Healing Hands: This seems to be her power. She was able to heal Vanya back into walking condition.
